prompt: Professional premium rigid packaging photography, one CONSISTENT product in a strict 3-column 2-row contact sheet, 3:2 overall. Six equal square cells, no borders/captions/text/logo. Cell6 blank. Product Partner appreciation set, Hexagonal lift-off box. Matching six-sided base and removable six-sided cap. Paper-wrapped rigid greyboard, Smooth matte printed wrapping paper, Lavender and slate, Blind embossed motif and small foil accent, precise geometric border. EMPTY insert: a card pocket and two gift recesses. Cell1 CLOSED full 3/4 hero. Cell2 OPEN: Open view: two detached matching HEXAGONAL parts side by side with wide gap. Six sides each. No hinge. Cell3 closed rear/side same design. Cell4 overhead close view of the SAME empty insert inside base. Cell5 close paper/finish/corner detail. In detachable structures never prop the lid against the base or stand it behind it; rest it flat alongside with a clear empty gap.
